title: Open-source peer artifact, profile, and route boundaries
mode: Primary-source web research and plan-only comparator audit
scope: Refresh operation and artifact boundaries for dwg-rs, cq-acis, uncad, and FreeCAD.
Separate mutable branch documentation from pinned released capability and actual parser/writer route.
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 and consumer comparator admission without adding implementation or support claims.

sources.revision: Mutable README reviewed 2026-10-20; no immutable source revision pinned or executed
sources.observed: README reports per-record boundary checks, nine named current errors (six VIEWPORT, two MESH, one LEADER), unmatched MATERIAL/TABLESTYLE, and warns aggregate percentages compare different corpus denominators. Project describes itself as pre-alpha, spec-based, with alpha writers. These are project-reported observations, not independently verified runtime results.

sources.revision: Pinned 0.3.12 source commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889 plus mutable main docs reviewed 2026-10-20; no wheel installed or run
sources.observed: The project distinguishes parse retention from shape conversion; unsupported referenced geometry fails conversion rather than silently returning a partial solid. The pinned geometry document labels cylinder seam/shell closure and oblique-cylinder profiles unreleased. The current README says the project test corpus is excluded from distributions and separately licensed. Conversion goes through CadQuery/OCCT.

sources.revision: Mutable README and About metadata reviewed 2026-10-20; no source revision pinned or executed
sources.observed: Repository About metadata advertises writing, but README says read-only. DWG parsing is LibreDWG FFI; DXF parsing is the separate undxf crate; output is JSON/SVG/PNG. The DWG route is not independent of LibreDWG and the documented package is not a writer candidate.

sources.revision: Mutable documentation source reviewed 2026-10-20; no FreeCAD build executed
sources.observed: The document describes distinct built-in C++ and optional legacy Python DXF importers with differing entity coverage, and states stock FreeCAD cannot read DXF ACIS/SAT solids. This is route guidance, not verification of a particular installed build.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: admit at most one pinned peer for a specific unresolved route; record immutable artifact, profile, direction/version, corpus denominator, and full unsupported/loss disposition.
3D semantic gate: use only released cq-acis profiles; keep raw parsing, conversion, analytic semantics, and consumer acceptance separate.
Consumer route inventory: correct uncad's stale About tagline from its documented read-only route; treat DWG via LibreDWG and DXF via undxf separately.

planChanges: Update comparator admission to use per-version dwg-rs denominators and its current named reader gaps rather than aggregate coverage claims.
Exclude cq-acis profiles explicitly labeled unreleased from the candidate released-capability denominator; require exact wheel, source, and dependency-set identity before an optional run.

Record parser unknowns and conversion failures separately, require complete body-reachable disposition and independently authored analytic metrics, and do not count OCCT/CadQuery as a kernel independent from FreeCAD.
Correct uncad's stale About metadata classification: its current README describes a read-only tool, DWG via LibreDWG FFI, and DXF via undxf; do not use it as an independent DWG parser or writer.
Keep FreeCAD qualification bound to exact importer backend/build/options and do not treat the stock DXF route as an ACIS semantic oracle.
Preserve the fast implementation cadence: no peer build/run per code slice, no external fixture imports, and self-unblock to local implementation if artifact/profile admission is not quick.
limitations: dwg-rs and uncad observations are from mutable repository README/source descriptions; neither was pinned, built, or executed here.
cq-acis source and current branch documentation are not a runtime result; no wheel or geometry kernel was installed or run.
FreeCAD documentation is route guidance and does not establish behavior for every platform or installed importer version.
No ODA DWG byte-layout claim was changed; the ODA v5.4.1 specification remains authoritative for DWG layout questions.
